description: This file defines error handling and messaging for the SQL Scripting Language interpreter within Apache Spark, including error classes, messages, and exception creation methods.

classes.name: SqlScriptingErrors
classes.description: Object containing methods for generating specific error messages and exceptions related to SQL scripting errors in Spark.

methods.name: duplicateLabels
methods.description: Creates an exception for duplicate label or variable name.

methods.name: labelsMismatch
methods.description: Creates an exception for mismatched labels.

methods.name: endLabelWithoutBeginLabel
methods.description: Creates an exception when an end label is used without a corresponding begin label.

methods.name: labelOrForVariableNameForbidden
methods.description: Creates an exception when a label or variable name is forbidden.

methods.name: variableDeclarationNotAllowedInScope
methods.description: Creates an exception for variable declaration outside allowed scope.

methods.name: variableDeclarationOnlyAtBeginning
methods.description: Creates an exception for variable declaration not at the beginning.

methods.name: invalidBooleanStatement
methods.description: Creates an exception for invalid boolean statement.

methods.name: sqlScriptingNotEnabled
methods.description: Creates an exception when SQL scripting is not enabled.

methods.name: positionalParametersAreNotSupportedWithSqlScripting
methods.description: Creates an exception for unsupported positional parameters with SQL scripting.

methods.name: labelDoesNotExist
methods.description: Creates an exception when a label does not exist.

methods.name: invalidIterateLabelUsageForCompound
methods.description: Creates an exception for invalid label usage in compound statements.

methods.name: labelCannotBeQualified
methods.description: Creates an exception when a label is improperly qualified.

methods.name: conditionCannotBeQualified
methods.description: Creates an exception for improperly qualified condition.

methods.name: conditionDeclarationNotAtStartOfCompound
methods.description: Creates an exception when a condition declaration is not at the start of a compound.

methods.name: conditionDeclarationContainsSpecialCharacter
methods.description: Creates an exception for special characters in condition declaration.

methods.name: duplicateConditionInScope
methods.description: Creates an exception for duplicate condition in scope.

methods.name: handlerDeclarationInWrongPlace
methods.description: Creates an exception for handler declaration in wrong place.

methods.name: duplicateConditionInHandlerDeclaration
methods.description: Creates an exception for duplicate condition in handler.

methods.name: duplicateSqlStateInHandlerDeclaration
methods.description: Creates an exception for duplicate SQL state in handler.

methods.name: duplicateHandlerForSameCondition
methods.description: Creates an exception for duplicate handler for the same condition.

methods.name: duplicateHandlerForSameSqlState
methods.description: Creates an exception for duplicate handler for the same SQL state.

methods.name: continueHandlerNotSupported
methods.description: Creates an exception when continue handler is not supported.

methods.name: invalidSqlStateValue
methods.description: Creates an exception for invalid SQL state value.

methods.name: sqlExceptionOrNotFoundCannotBeCombinedWithOtherConditions
methods.description: Creates an exception when combining certain conditions is invalid.

methods.name: conditionNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception when a condition is not found.
